item.title: Why don’t we have a public train system in Ocala?
item.description: "Why doesn't Ocala have a train, metro, or subway system? The tracks are already here. There's a set of tracks by Lockheed Martin in the shores that go straight up into town and right into the square downtown. Everyone is complaining about too many drivers and how bad State Road 200 is, why not bring in a subway? The infrastructure is already here.
